title: Rejects on two lines: enough counts?
intro: Line A made 6 rejects in 80 parts and line B 3 in 90. Before comparing the two reject rates, check the success–failure condition. The expected counts of this 2 × 2 table are exactly n₁p̂, n₁(1 − p̂), n₂p̂ and n₂(1 − p̂), with p̂ the pooled proportion; each should be at least 10 (some textbooks use 5). The chi-square test on the table is the two-sided two-proportion z-test: χ² = z².
